title: Pullback Roos chain maps respect scalar towers
statement: For finite coefficient fields E,L,F over Q_l with maps iota:E→L and j:L→F, every scheme morphism f:X→Y and every cochain complex P of completed E-coefficient modules on Y, the explicit pullback chain comparison [lem-pur-integral-scalar-finite-comparison-models] satisfies S_j,X(delta_iota(P));delta_j(S_iota,Y(P));P_F(kappa_Y(P)) = kappa_X(P_E(P));delta_(j iota)(P), where kappa is the termwise normalized scalar associator of [lem-weil-scalar-extension-composition]. No boundedness, flatness or completeness is assumed for P.

source.place: Tensor reassociation, evaluation and coefficient comparisons; scalar-comparison proof step 9 of lem-pur-integral-operations-scalar-extension; Stacks 03EL, 07A4, 08J9 and 08TC.

proof.text: On each finite pullback generator both routes multiply the two newly introduced coefficients in the same order; normalized pullback maps insert the same units. The extension/restriction adjunction, balance and sheafification extend the generator equality to each finite level. The consecutive reduction equations make the level equalities an equality of strict tower maps. Projection to each unshifted and shifted Roos product coordinate reduces the required equality to the finite-level equality, since finite free extension commutes with the products. The reduction squares respect the signed Roos differential. Joint injectivity of the projections in each degree gives equality of the chain maps.

lean.statement:
theorem integralScalarPullbackChainTower {X Y : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (P : CochainComplex (integralTowerModules l E Y) ℤ) :
    ((integralOrdinaryScalar l L F j X).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).map
        (scalarPullbackChain l E L ι f P) ≫
      scalarPullbackChain l L F j f
        (((integralOrdinaryScalar l E L ι Y).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P) ≫
      (integralOperationsPullbackComplexFunctor l F f).map
        ((NatIso.mapHomologicalComplex (integralOrdinaryScalarComp l E L ι Y F j)
          (.up ℤ)).hom.app P) =
    (NatIso.mapHomologicalComplex (integralOrdinaryScalarComp l E L ι X F j)
      (.up ℤ)).hom.app ((integralOperationsPullbackComplexFunctor l E f).obj P) ≫
        scalarPullbackChain l E F (j.comp ι) f P
